title: death
summary: MSUI covers the main death arc: the dead/alive edge derived from the self entity, Release Spirit (CMSG_REPOP_REQUEST gated on being dead), SMSG_CORPSE_RECLAIM_DELAY armed at arrival and gating reclaim, CMSG_RECLAIM_CORPSE with the streamed corpse object's guid, SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST -> accept/decline via CMSG_RESURRECT_RESPONSE, CMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_ACTIVATE, and durability-loss observation. 8/13 tracked opcodes hit; the two missing ones are player-visible.

openItems.text: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY is never sent/consumed: the corpse location is known only once the corpse OBJECT streams into range, so there is no corpse position for the run back (no map/minimap corpse marker, no dungeon-entrance stand-in for a corpse inside an instance).
SMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_CONFIRM unhandled: no XP-loss/durability confirm two-step before spirit-healer resurrection - activation is sent directly without the reference's CONFIRM_XP_LOSS popup.
